|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/icantbelievehesgone.html</ref>

Have you ever had [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] dueled and put out of play? Well, for great justice, then this is the card for you. Take advantage of your disadvantage by using this card to increase your power in battles and hopefully inflict some battle damage on your opponent for your trouble.

Since [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Obi-Wan]] is very likely to be dueled and placed out of play during your opponent's turn, you may not have saved Force to deploy this card. Worried that you will never get this card on the table? [[Fear]] not because [[Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty){{!}}Wise Advice]] from Special Edition (or the combo version, Do Or Do Not/[[Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty){{!}}Wise Advice]]) makes your Immediate Effects deploy for free. Once you have this card on the table, you are immensely stronger. You basically have a free 'crazy old wizard' adding his 5 power in all your battles everywhere.

Combo:

Any deck that uses the [[Death Star II (Dark){{!}}Death Star II]] effect (such as a deck using the [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him{{!}}There Is Good In Him]] objective) will benefit from higher power, making the crossing of [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] to the Light Side easier.
|combos=* [[I Can't Believe He's Gone]] + [[I Feel The Conflict]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=I%20Can%27t%20Believe%20He%27s%20Gone</ref>
|rulings=* Obi needs to be placed OOP from table (e.g. [[Noble Sacrifice]] or [[The Circle Is Now Complete]]), or while 'just lost' (e.g. [[Darth Sidious]] or [[Dannik Jerriko]]).<ref name="scomp" />
